```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    # Every 5 minutes
    - cron: "*/5 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  cleanup-unmergeable-prs:
    name: Remove UNMERGEABLE PRs from Merge Queue
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get unmergeable PRs from merge queue
        id: get_unmergeable
        run: |
          # Get all PRs in the merge queue that are marked as UNMERGEABLE
          PRS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges" \
            | jq -r '.[] | select(.status == "UNMERGEABLE") | .number')
          
          echo "unmergeable_prs<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$PRS" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          if [ -z "$PRS" ]; then
            echo "No unmergeable PRs found"
            echo "has_unmergeable=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "Found unmergeable PRs: $PRS"
            echo "has_unmergeable=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Remove unmergeable PRs and comment
        if: env.has_unmergeable == 'true'
        run: |
          IFS=$'\n'
          for pr_number in ${{ env.unmergeable_prs }}; do
            echo "Processing PR #$pr_number"
            
            # Remove the PR from the merge queue
            curl -s -X DELETE \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges/$pr_number" \
              > /dev/null
            
            # Post a comment explaining the removal
            COMMENT_BODY="This PR was removed from the merge queue because it became \`UNMERGEABLE\`. Please rebase your branch to resolve conflicts and then re-add this PR to the merge queue.

\`\`\`
git fetch origin
git checkout ${{ github.head_ref }}
git rebase origin/main
git push origin ${{ github.head_ref }} --force-with-lease
\`\`\`

After pushing, you can re-add this PR to the merge queue by commenting \`@nexi-lab/nexus merge\` on this PR."
            
            curl -s -X POST \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              -d "{\"body\":\"$COMMENT_BODY\"}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/$pr_number/comments" \
              > /dev/null
            
            echo "Removed PR #$pr_number from merge queue and posted comment"
          done
```
